description: An abstract class defining an Akka stream-based actor with customizable message mapping, sink creation, supervision strategy, and stream handling logic. It manages message flow via Akka streams, tracks metrics, and handles exceptions within the stream.

classes.name: AbstractGraphActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that uses a stream graph for message processing, providing hooks for message mapping, sink creation, supervision, and stream management, with integrated metrics and exception handling.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to convert incoming messages of type M to type T for processing in the stream.

methods.name: beforeProcessMessage
methods.description: Hook to modify or enhance a message before it is processed in the stream.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Abstract method to provide the sink where processed messages are directed.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the buffer size for the Source queue.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the Akka receive behavior for handling messages, setting up the stream source queue and message handling logic.

methods.name: getSupervisionStrategyAttribute
methods.description: Provides stream supervision strategy, primarily to resume on exceptions and log errors.

methods.name: getSourceQueue
methods.description: Creates and returns the SourceQueueWithComplete for message enqueuing, with attached logging, flow, supervision, and materialization.

methods.name: incrementDequeueCounter
methods.description: Helper to increment the dequeued messages counter.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Hook for adding custom matchers to the ReceiveBuilder before default processing.

methods.name: handleDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Handles DittoRuntimeException by returning it to the sender.

methods.name: handleMatched
methods.description: Processes matched messages, logs details, increments metric counters, and offers the message to the sources queue.

methods.name: incrementEnqueueCounters
methods.description: Updates the counters based on the result of enqueue attempts.

methods.name: handleUnknownThrowable
methods.description: Handles unexpected throwable errors by logging and returning an internal error to sender.
